title.en: AIE study visit to Seattle and Boise

summary.en: Selected by the AIE program to take part in a study visit to Seattle, Washington, and Boise, Idaho, which included visits to the [University of Washington](https://www.washington.edu/visit/), [Google](https://about.google/company-info/locations/), [Amazon](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/locations/hq1), [Microsoft](https://news.microsoft.com/redmond-campus/), the [Allen Institute for AI (Ai2)](https://allenai.org/about), and [Micron](https://www.micron.com/about/locations).
